messages:
alex: Quick follow-up on the onprem packaging RFC — thinking about egress constraints for operator-driven upgrades in fully air-gapped sites. TL;DR: can we design prefetch/approve flow so operator never needs outbound write access? Questions inline.

maria: +1. We need a clear RBAC + network policy set. Operators should be able to stage bundles without any outbound egress except to a local staging registry.

jon: two modes here I still like:
- Pull-proxy: the operator ships a USB/registry snapshot to the site, a local registry sidecar (seed-proxy) serves artifacts, operator triggers reconcile.
- Push-bundle: operator signs a bundle offsite, courier delivers and operator applies it locally.
Both need signer rotation/rollback semantics.

sophie: dual-image-swap pattern for upgrades works well: keep previous verified bundle locally so rollback is atomic.

samir: important: manifest should encode "fetch plan" to avoid pulling whole model shards. Prefetch heuristics:
1) active-route shards first
2) small size metadata + bloom filter to decide shard necessity
This keeps egress to local copy only.

kevin: ops UX: a signed approval flow where console issues an offline "approval token" (QR/PKCS7) the onprem operator imports. No persistent outbound creds.

alex: sketch of a NetworkPolicy we considered:
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: seed-proxy-only
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: seed-proxy
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: local-registry
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 5000
```
This enforces no external egress from operator pods.

opsbot: note: if seed-proxy is used, ensure local-registry image has attestation hook for signatures.

maria: on signer rotation: keep a signer history in the manifest and require operator approval for unknown-signers > 30d. We should surface unknown-signer warnings in console and on-device CLI.

jon: rollback safety: atomic activation window + leader election so two simultaneous activations can't race. Also double-check compatibility via preflight (dry-run apply) using the seed-proxy.

sophie: I'll prototype seed-proxy sidecar and dual-image swap POC. Will include an offline approval token import flow.

alex: agreed. action items: update RFC with RBAC matrix, NetworkPolicy examples, manifest fetch-plan, signer-history semantics, and a POC branch. target: draft PR by next Wednesday.

kevin: ack. I'll draft the RBAC and console flows.

samir: I'll write a small manifest schema addendum for fetch-plan + signer history.

alex: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
